title: 4x4 Unsigned Multiplier
statement: Implement a 4x4 unsigned multiplier that produces an 8-bit product for two 4-bit operands. The module must be purely combinational and suitable for use in a small datapath block. This exercise covers boolean multiplication and partial product accumulation.
module_signature: module unsigned_multiplier_4x4(input [3:0] a, input [3:0] b, output [7:0] product);
behavior: No sequential or registered logic may be used.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use behavioral loops to build the multiplier if you want a structural solution.
hint: Think of partial products and addition of shifted terms.
